title: Iterated creation, grading, and revision of data science projects by language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05548v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We evaluate the extent to which agentic AI models can complete an end-to-end data science project, and how this improves with feedback. A 'writer' model with specific tools creates a complete data science project including downloading, cleaning, and analyzing a dataset, and writing a short paper about it. The project is executed and a 'grader' model evaluates it. The writer can then revise its submission, and this repeats for a total of three rounds. We consider seven models from five developers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, and Z.AI. Each model is both a writer and a grader, so there are 49 writer-grader pairs and we run each pair three times. Of the 147 initial submissions, 107 run and render, and the average score increases from 59 per cent to 76 per cent after the final round of feedback. By writer the extent of the increase ranges from 3 percentage points for Anthropic's Opus 5.5 to 46 percentage points for Anthropic's Haiku

translated_title: 语言模型对数据科学项目的迭代式创建、评分与修订
translated_abstract: 我们评估了智能体AI模型能够完成端到端数据科学项目的程度，以及这一能力如何随反馈而提升。一个配备特定工具的“写作者”模型创建一个完整的数据科学项目，包括下载数据集、清洗和分析数据集，并就此撰写一篇短论文。项目随后被执行，并由一个“评分者”模型进行评估。写作者模型接着可以修改其提交内容，如此重复共进行三轮。我们考虑了来自五个开发商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、DeepSeek和Z.AI）的七个模型。每个模型既充当写作者又充当评分者，因此共有49个写作者-评分者组合，我们对每个组合运行三次。在147份初始提交中，107份能够成功运行并渲染，经过最后一轮反馈后，平均得分从59%提升至76%。按写作者模型来看，提升幅度从Anthropic的Opus 5.5的3个百分点到Anthropic的Haiku的46个百分点不等。
tldr: 本研究通过“写作者-评分者”迭代反馈框架评估七个语言模型完成端到端数据科学项目的能力，发现三轮反馈修订使平均得分从59%提升至76%，且不同模型提升幅度差异显著（3至46个百分点）。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates seven language models' ability to complete end-to-end data science projects through a writer-grader iterative feedback framework, showing that three rounds of feedback and revision raise average scores from 59% to 76%, with improvements varying widely across models (3 to 46 percentage points).
